name: Sealos
line: Managed SQL, document, cache, vector, and Kafka services on one cloud platform.

free.text: 7d: 4 vCPU/4GB RAM, 5GB storage, 500MB bandwidth; post-trial data policy unknown

cells.metered: Starter $34/mo; 2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM, 10 GiB disk
cells.regions: Managed region list is not published
cells.selfhost: Yes, internal use only; SSL bars third-party cloud service

sql.math: The $34 package includes 2 vCPUs, 2 GiB of RAM and 10 GiB of disk. The region, connection limits and performance fit are not verified.
The kept package stays at $34 a month when idle. The exact database fit and any optional backup charges are unknown.

files.math: S3-compatible storage is included on paid plans. Object storage capacity is not tied to the package disk, and no rate for 100 GB is published.

jobs.math: The Hobby plan has 4 vCPUs and 4 GiB of RAM for a peak of 2.5 vCPUs and 2.5 GB. Cron limits and whether the workers fit are not verified.
